description: Claude 3 Opus is Anthropic's most powerful model in the Claude 3 family, designed for highly complex tasks requiring deep analysis and nuanced understanding. It offers the highest level of intelligence and capability.

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse corpus of text and image data using Constitutional AI (CAI) methods.

trainingProcedure: Trained using Constitutional AI (CAI), Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), and extensive safety evaluations.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Highest capability Claude 3 model. Excels at complex reasoning, coding, and analysis tasks. Near-human level on many expert tasks.

knownLimitations: Slower and more expensive than Sonnet and Haiku
May generate incorrect or misleading information
Can exhibit biases present in training data
Lower max output tokens than Claude 3.5 Sonnet

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Anthropic uses Constitutional AI to reduce harmful outputs and biases.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Constitutional AI training, extensive red-teaming, and content filtering.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: API data is not used to train models by default.

requirements.deployment: API-only (cloud-hosted by Anthropic), also available via AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI
